name: Tata Elxsi Ltd
about: Tata Elxsi is amongst the world’s leading providers of design and technology services across industries including Automotive, Media, Communications and Healthcare. Tata Elxsi provides integrated services from research and strategy, to electronics and mechanical design, software development, validation and deployment, and is supported by a network of design studios, global development centers and offices worldwide. business.what: Tata Elxsi provides design and technology services for product engineering and innovation. It serves industries including automotive, media, communications, and healthcare, helping clients develop products, digital experiences, and AI-powered solutions.

ledger.promise: PBT margin of 27% by Q4 FY27
ledger.quote: today, we are upwards of 25.6 in Q4 last financial year, we want to take it to 27 in Q4 FY '27, right?
ledger.actual: PBT margin stood at 22.7% in Q1 FY27 and 22.6% in Q2 FY27. Target quarter Q4 FY27 has not occurred.

ledger.promise: Higher single-digit revenue growth in FY27
ledger.quote: when we came in the last quarter, we were hoping for a double-digit growth aspirations for the quarter. But looking at the situation today, maybe, I would be a little more conservative and say maybe a higher single digit
ledger.actual: H1 FY27 revenue reached Rs 2,077 crore, up 14.8% YoY compared to H1 FY26 revenue of Rs 1,810 crore.

ledger.promise: Large hiring to resume at 80-82% utilization
ledger.quote: once the utilization touches 80% or 82%, that is when I think we will be looking at adding more in larger numbers, right?
ledger.actual: Utilization figures and headcount additions are not reported in the provided financial filings.

ledger.promise: Sequential margin ramp-up from Q2 to Q4 FY27
ledger.quote: Post that, you know, once the wage hikes are fully sort of baked in, we should sort of see a ramp-up in margins as we go through the rest of the year as sort of our revenues pick up
ledger.actual: EBITDA margin increased sequentially from 21.2% in Q1 FY27 to 21.9% in Q2 FY27.

ledger.promise: Shift onsite-offshore delivery mix to 75% offshore
ledger.quote: You know, we would be in that, you know, 75/25, 75 being offshore and 25 being onsite... we will over the, over the subsequent few quarters... be able to, you know, move a lot of this work back offshore
ledger.actual: Offshore/onsite delivery ratios are not disclosed in quarterly financial statements.

ledger.promise: Gradual EBITDA margin improvement over next 2 to 3 quarters
ledger.quote: we will have to progressively move towards, over the next, I would say, 2 to 3 quarters, we will see that gradual improvement in our margins
ledger.actual: EBITDA margin improved from 21.2% in Q1 FY27 to 21.9% in Q2 FY27; future quarters remain pending.

ledger.promise: H2 FY27 revenue to exceed H1 FY27 and grow YoY
ledger.quote: We expect 2H to be better than 1H, it would imply that our revenues would be higher even on a Y-o-Y basis in H2.
ledger.actual: H1 FY27 revenue reached Rs 2,077 crore. H2 FY27 reported results are pending.

credibility.label: mixed
credibility.summary: Management scaled back revenue growth expectations from double-digit to high single-digit in FY27 due to delayed deal closures and customer bankruptcies. Margin targets remain under pressure as current PBT margins of ~22.6% track below the management aspiration of 27% for Q4 FY27.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Q1 FY27 margins were heavily impacted by customer bankruptcy provisions and non-recurring project costs.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: EBITDA margin dropped from 24.6% in Q4 FY26 to 21.2% in Q1 FY27, with PAT falling from Rs 220 crore to Rs 171 crore.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Management targets taking PBT margin to 27% by Q4 FY27.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: PBT margin was 22.7% in Q1 FY27 and 22.6% in Q2 FY27, remaining significantly below the 27% target level.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Margins should begin a gradual recovery in Q2 FY27 as revenue picks up.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Revenue grew from Rs 1,021 crore in Q1 FY27 to Rs 1,056 crore in Q2 FY27, while EBITDA margin improved from 21.2% to 21.9%.

bull.point: Sequential revenue growth and EBITDA margin recovery in H1 FY27
bull.evidence: Quarterly revenue expanded from Rs 1,021 crore in Q1 FY27 to Rs 1,056 crore in Q2 FY27, while EBITDA margin rose from 21.2% to 21.9%.

bull.point: Management expects accelerated top-line performance in H2 FY27
bull.evidence: Management explicitly guided that H2 FY27 revenues will exceed H1 FY27 (Rs 2,077 crore) and show YoY growth.

bull.point: Deleveraged balance sheet with reduced debt liabilities
bull.evidence: Borrowings declined from Rs 225 crore in FY24 to Rs 143 crore in FY27, with Capital WIP maintained at zero.

bear.point: Margins remain depressed relative to historical levels and Q4 FY27 targets
bear.evidence: EBITDA margins of 21.2%-21.9% in H1 FY27 remain well below Q2 FY25 levels of 27.9% and trail the 27% PBT margin target.

bear.point: Persistent deal conversion delays in key OEM and Healthcare accounts
bear.evidence: Management reported decision-making delays among European OEMs and deal closure cycles extending up to 6 months in Healthcare.
Debtor days increased from 95 days in FY25 to 105 days in FY26, stretching the cash conversion cycle to 105 days.
